gi2_templates.rule: Character sheet: define identity anchors (face shape, main hairstyle, outfit markers, proportions) first, then pose and expression; state 'same character, same proportions' before the action list; lock the grid (panel count, numbering) for multi-panel sheets; identity preservation keeps face identity, main hairstyle and expression temperament.

gi2_style_library.rule: Character Design Sheet: define identity anchors, outfit, proportions, pose count and layout; keep face, hairstyle and costume consistent; street-snap/phone-documentary looks add negative constraints against staged poses and fake ad lighting.

facial_expression_skill.rule: Describe visible anatomy (FACS action units) instead of emotion words; intensity 1–5; avoid an instant full-tooth smile for restrained amusement; perfect bilateral symmetry looks posed or synthetic; strong cheek lift with fully widened eyes is inconsistent.

facs.rule: Ekman & Friesen Facial Action Coding System — the action-unit vocabulary used above.

cinematic_catalog.rule: Framing and camera-angle slugs for varying the shot.

nano_banana_prompts.rule: Largest curated prompt library for Google's image model (Flow/Gemini); browse its portrait/selfie categories when a new look is needed.

identityAnchors.rule: Lock these in every prompt, before anything else (gi2_templates).
persona-01: same face as the reference image
light freckles across nose and cheeks
warm dark-brown eyes with soft double eyelids and aegyo-sal

expressions.prompt: mild cheek lift and lip corners rising with a slight asymmetry, outer eyes softly narrowed, lips closed

expressions.prompt: neutral soft face, gaze drifting off-camera to the side, lips relaxed and slightly parted, brows at rest
brows lifted, upper lids raised, lips parted in a small O, just before a smile breaks
expressions.facs: AU1+2 C + AU5 B + AU25/26 B

expressions.prompt: concentrating on a task, brows drawn slightly together, lower lids firm, lips pressed
expressions.facs: AU4 A + AU7 B + AU24 A

expressions.prompt: one lip corner lifted, mild lid tension, direct gaze into the lens
lips gathered forward in a small pout, one brow raised, teasing look
heavy relaxed lids, slow blink, faint smile, just woken up

mid-bite, cheeks full, eyes widening at the taste

side profile by a window, chin slightly raised
crouching on her heels on the street, forearms on knees
leaning back against a wall, one knee bent, hands in pockets

sitting cross-legged on the floor, leaning forward on her elbows

back to the camera, looking at the view

hairStyling.rule: Length and color are identity anchors; styling changes. Styling phrases seen in curated prompts: "ponytail with soft front strands framing her face", "half-up with a delicate ribbon", "baseball cap", "wet-look texture" (https://github.com/YouMind-OpenLab/awesome-nano-banana-pro-prompts (README, 13.5k stars)); the rest are common hair vocabulary (assumption until checked side by side).
styles: clipped back with a claw clip
low mini ponytail with loose strands
side part flipped to the other side
sourced: ponytail with soft front strands framing her face

setRules: In one set, no two images share the same expression, pose, hair styling or framing.
At most one broad full-tooth smile per set (facial_expression_skill: avoid the instant full-tooth smile as a default).
Keep slight asymmetry in expressions; no perfectly symmetrical faces (facial_expression_skill).
Candid/phone-documentary sets add 'not a staged pose, no ad lighting' (gi2_style_library).

cues.cue: skin pores, freckles, slight film grain — add imperfections, a too-perfect face looks fake

shot on a modern smartphone, ~24–26 mm equivalent wide-angle, handheld front-facing camera, vertical 9:16, natural HDR, realistic smartphone dynamic range, slight computational-photography characteristics, subtle lens softness
feel like an authentic smartphone travel photograph rather than a polished professional photograph
